content.title: Cava (CAVA) Margin Surge Reinforces Growth Narrative, Ups Profit Expectations for Investors
content.summary: CAVA Group (CAVA) posted another standout quarter, with revenue on track to grow 16.6% annually, easily topping the US market average. EPS is projected to see a 22.6% yearly gain, net margins have climbed to 13% from last year’s 5%, and bottom-line growth for the past year clocked in at 231.3%, well above the five-year average of 106.7%.
